`base` is the root of the module graph, and the paths of the modules inside the bundle are relative to it. It must contain every module in the bundle, and `stow()` throws if a module is outside it. It defaults to the closest directory that contains every module. Before v0.1.6 it defaulted to the directory containing `entry`, and the CLI used the working directory.
